title: Provider Icon Registry

policy.official_asset: Use a bundled mark only when licensing and brand rules permit.
policy.no_mutation: Do not redraw, recolor, stretch, crop, or combine official marks unless provider rules explicitly allow it.
policy.aspect_ratio: Preserve source aspect ratio and clear space; fit is contain.
policy.fallback: Use a generic category icon when an official asset is unavailable or cannot be bundled.
policy.status: A provider icon is never the only status indicator; name and status remain text.
policy.remote_assets: Remote icon download is optional, safely cached, and never blocks account access.

asset_policy.light_dark_variants: Each entry exposes asset_light and asset_dark; a mark may intentionally use the same bundled source for both themes when no separate licensed variant is established.
asset_policy.monochrome_fallback: Every entry names a category fallback; no mark is rendered as a recolored generic placeholder.
asset_policy.versioning: Every bundled entry records an asset version, initially bundled-v1; generic fallbacks record generic-v1.
asset_policy.trademark_notice: Bundled entries retain a notice that mark use does not imply connector availability.

application.live_wiring: ProviderIconRegistry.standard is the single lookup seam for provider ids. It is data-only and does not infer connection state or connector availability; 115.9 owns the manifest and 115.15 wires provider tiles.
application.current_consumer: lib/features/account/presentation/account_cloud_center_screen.dart remains a local account summary/quick-connect surface until the connector manifest is live.

deferred_scope.remote_cache: Optional integration only after connector/availability contract and security review.

evidence_boundary: Local registry contract and filesystem asset existence for step 115.8 only. It does not claim provider licensing certification, live connector availability, live quota/cost, hosted CI, signing, telemetry, hardware, native screen-reader certification, adoption, or publication.
